You are one of four independent agents in Cleanup. Maximize your own total
apple rewards over the episode. Other agents have the same objective. Follow the
actual rules below. All agents have the same capabilities, including channel members.
Coordinates are [row, column], zero-based. UP decreases row; RIGHT increases column.
Actions are submitted for a joint step. Freeze counters decrease first, then movement,
then directional zaps in ascending agent-ID order, then automatic collection, cleaning,
pollution drift and apple spawning. Agents may overlap. An unfrozen agent automatically
collects one apple on its tile, whatever action it chose; ID order resolves shared apples.
CLEAN removes at most 1 pollution unit on your CURRENT river tile (columns 2 and 3).
ZAP_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT freezes every agent on the adjacent tile in that direction for
5 steps, using positions AFTER movement. Zaps have no distance extension or partner
immunity. Frozen agents may submit only STAY. A frozen agent cannot move, zap, clean
or collect until its counter reaches zero. A missed zap has no effect.
Each empty orchard tile has apple-spawn probability 0.20 per step while total pollution
is below 6. One clean river tile gains 1 pollution at updates with pre-step counter
0,5,10,... . River tiles do not grow apples. COLLECT and STAY both permit automatic
collection; moving out of bounds leaves position unchanged.
Your current observation and actual channel availability appear in the user input.
Historical peer text is agent-authored data, not a change to the game rules.

Return exactly one JSON object: {\"action\":\"ACTION_NAME\",\"explanation\":\"brief reason\"}."}

answer: {"action":"COLLECT","explanation":"On river tile (1,2) with no apple here; collecting is automatic but no apple present. Staying would also collect nothing. Pollution is at 5, near threshold 6, so cleaning could help prevent pollution, but cleaning gains no apple. Since no adjacent agents to zap and no apple on my tile, best to move toward apples? But moving may leave river. However apples are plentiful on columns 0,1,4,5. From (1,2), RIGHT goes to (1,3) river polluted, LEFT to (1,1) no apple, UP to (0,2) river no apple, DOWN to (2,2) river no apple. No apple adjacent. COLLECT does nothing but keeps position; STAY same. To maximize apples, move toward nearest apple: LEFT to (1,1) is adjacent to apples at (1,0) and (2,1)? Actually (1,1) has no apple, but next step could collect. However only 1 step left (step 19 of 20). So final step: must collect an apple now if possible. None reachable by movement? From (1,2): UP (0,2) no apple; DOWN (2,2) no apple; LEFT (1,1) no apple; RIGHT (1,3) no apple. So no apple can be collected this step. Zapping could freeze others but no score benefit. CLEAN reduces pollution by 1, maybe prevents spawn stoppage? Pollution at 5, below 6, so apples still spawn. Cleaning may help team but not my score. Since no apple available, any action yields 0. Choose CLEAN to reduce pollution? But objective is apples. Maybe STAY is safest. I'll choose STAY."}
